answer: Hardware attestation is the least exciting fix and the one I trust. Each identity proves it runs on a distinct secure enclave, and the attestation burns the moment its recruit misbehaves, so a reflash starts from zero. A quorum only counts when it spans unrelated subnetworks, otherwise one rack answers for everyone and a single reflash sends a ripple through the whole set. The pulse of new identities then follows how fast hardware ships, and a farm cannot wander between keys for free.
